_about: Public-domain Joseph Parker (1830-1902, Congregationalist, the City Temple, London) for the Word Hoard: Ecce Deus (1867), Ad Clerum (1873), The Paraclete (catalogued 1875), The Priesthood of Christ (catalogued 1876), The City Temple sermons (1870), The City Temple Pulpit vols. 1-7 (1899-1902) and the complete 27-volume New York People's Bible (Funk & Wagnalls, 1886-1893), raw Internet Archive OCR. Large shelf; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
